message: Pairs are potential relationships only, not confirmed same-fire matches.

interpretation.observation: One distinct FIRMS source record (pixels with the same line_number in one daily image are grouped).
interpretation.candidate_pair: A MODIS-VIIRS pair that is close in space (and date); a POTENTIAL relationship only.
interpretation.unique_fire_events_note: Not determined. This system does not identify confirmed or unique fire events, and has not been scientifically validated for that purpose.

MODIS.product: MOD14/MYD14 via NASA LANCE/FIRMS, rasterized 1 km, NRT

data_provenance.retrieval: ALL unmasked fire pixels in the bbox were retrieved (not a sample); queries over the per-source pixel cap are refused rather than truncated.
assumptions: Observation = FIRMS source record (pixels with equal line_number in one image are grouped).
Coordinates are pixel centres (MODIS 1 km, VIIRS 375 m); positional uncertainty ~ pixel size.
Date matching uses the Earth Engine daily image date, assumed to be a UTC bin (not verified).
MODIS has no acquisition time in this dataset, so MODIS-VIIRS temporal matching is unavailable.
MODIS confidence (0-100 %) and VIIRS confidence (0/1/2) are different scales and are never converted.
Candidate pairs are potential relationships only; no fire events are identified or validated.

warnings: Temporal matching was not possible for any pair (missing acquisition timestamps); all pairs are spatial/date candidates only.
